messages.Un proiectil este lansat cu v₀ = 20 m/s: A projectile is launched at v₀ = 20 m/s and θ = 45°, with g = 9.81 m/s².
messages.Traiectoria este o parabolă — chiar func: The trajectory is a parabola: a quadratic function of x.
messages.O minge este aruncată în sus de la h₀ =: A ball is thrown upward from h₀ = 2 m, with v₀ = 12 m/s.
messages.Înălțimea în funcție de timp este exact: Height as a function of time is exactly quadratic: y = at² + bt + c.
messages.Un corp este lăsat să cadă de la H = 45: A body is dropped from H = 45 m, with zero initial speed.
messages.a < 0 (a = −g/2), deci parabola este des: a < 0 (a = −g/2), so the parabola opens downward, as for the projectile.
messages.Axa x este distanța parcursă (m), axa y: The x-axis shows distance (m), the y-axis height (m). The trajectory is a parabola: horizontal velocity is constant and vertical acceleration is constant.
messages.Axa x este distanța parcursă (m), iar ax: The x-axis shows distance (m), the y-axis height (m). The curve is the projectile trajectory; the orange point is its current position and the horizontal line marks maximum height. Eliminating time from the parametric equations gives the quadratic function y(x).
messages.h(t) este o funcție de gradul al doilea: h(t) is quadratic in time: a = −g/2 < 0, so the parabola opens downward and its vertex is a maximum.
messages.Axa x este timpul (s), axa y este înălți: The x-axis shows time (s), the y-axis height (m). The curve h(t) = h₀ + v₀t − gt²/2 is a downward-opening parabola. Its vertex gives the maximum height and the instant when the ball stops rising.
messages.Corpul pornește din repaus și accelereaz: The body starts at rest with constant acceleration; h(t) is a downward-opening parabola (a = −g/2).
messages.Axa x este timpul (s), axa y este înălți: The x-axis shows time (s), the y-axis height (m). The body starts at H with zero speed and accelerates under gravity; the graph is part of a downward-opening parabola.
